[[File:KoltoShippingPlatform.png|thumb|right|270px|The Shipping Docks during the Invasion of Manaan]]
The '''Shipping Docks''' were [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] dockyards located on a platform at the surface of the aquatic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. The docks were used by Imperial transport ships to carry [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] offworld. The platform was defended by an anti-orbital [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] that severely damaged attacking [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] starships during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="Dead" />
